review:
Alice in Wonderland on Megaways, with reels that grow taller in the bonus – so free spins can reach a huge number of ways.

The headline is the 97.24% RTP, one of the highest defaults you'll find in a big-studio slot. High volatility with a 17,420x max. If you like Megaways and care about long-term value, this is one of the best around.
